internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The 40 occurrences of م ل ا split into two Quran-internally coherent but mutually unbridged classes. Class A (10 occ: Form I verbs, a Form VIII verb, the passive, the active participle مَالِئُون, and the verbal noun مِلْء) means 'bring/reach a bounded interior to its full capacity with a content' — Hell filled with jinn and humans, bellies with food, the sky with guards, a person with terror, the earth as a measure of gold. Class B (30 occ: the lexicalized noun ٱلْمَلَأ in case/definiteness/possessive variants, incl. the heavenly ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ) means 'the eminent leading assembly/council that speaks, deliberates, and decides for a people or ruler.' No verse predicates filling of the mala', and no fill-word denotes a council; the shared particle مِن plays opposite roles (content-partitive in A vs. group-partitive in B). Any 'fullness -> the full/eminent body' bridge exists only in external etymology, which the source policy forbids. The honest root-level result is therefore that the packet does not license a single nucleus: two classes, no Quran-internal bridge.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Class A does NOT mean partial insertion or overflow: it is capacity reached, fixed internally by هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ / هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ (50:30) where 'full?' is contrasted with 'more?' (مَزِيد). It carries no fixed content-substance (jinn+humans, food, guards, terror, gold) and no moral valence (fills the punitive Hell and the protective sky alike), and licenses figurative interior-filling (رُعْبًا, 18:18). Class B does NOT mean the whole people (it is repeatedly ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ, a leadership subset of the قوم), does NOT mean the low stratum (it is opposed to أَرَاذِلُنَا 11:27 and ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا 7:75), does NOT mean the monarch (the malik addresses the malaʾ, 12:43; the malaʾ ask for a malik, 2:246), is NOT number-based (even indefinite مَلَأٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِ, 11:38), and is NOT inherently disbelieving (unbelief/arrogance is supplied by relative clauses ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا / ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا, absent in the neutral courts of 12:43, 27:29/32/38, 2:246). The 'heavenly' sense (37:8, 38:69) comes from the modifier ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ, not the root. Crucially, neither class crosses: Class A never denotes persons; Class B never denotes volume/quantity.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 27:38:3:2 — قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا: a vocative direct address to persons asked 'which of you will bring me her throne?' There is no container, content, capacity, or quantity; no Class-A fill/full/a-fill-of sense can be substituted without nonsense. This decisively resists any unified 'fullness' nucleus. The would-be bridge, 26:34:2:3 قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ ('to the assembly around him'), fails on inspection: حَوْلَهُ is a locative ظرف that places the persons, never a م ل ا fill-word, so the 'they fill the space around the ruler' reading imports external etymology the text does not state.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: The single-nucleus 'fullness/plenitude' account: treat ٱلْمَلَأ as 'those of full standing / the eminent whose presence fills the assembly,' unifying B under A's fullness idea (the classical derivation). Its appeal is morphological economy — one consonantal root, one story — and its best foothold is 26:34 حَوْلَهُ. It is rejected as the Quran-internal result because (i) the source policy bars the classical etymology as authority; (ii) no mala' context supplies any filling/capacity cue; (iii) the internal evidence runs the other way — mala' is a subset (مِن قَوْمِهِ), the opposite of 'completeness of the group,' and is defined by status contrast (vs. أَرَاذِل / مُستَضعَفون), not by measure. The unification is an external prior doing no Quran-internal explanatory work.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three independent lenses converged on the same split and the same negative result on unification, differing only in how to grade it. The contract is decisive here: 'If two+ senses have NO Quran-internal bridge (incl. homonyms), choose UNRESOLVED — do NOT force one nucleus.' Class A is internally STRONG (five morphological shapes, five distinct contents, adversarially clean, no resistant member) and Class B is internally coherent (a lexicalized collective noun consistent across ~9 narrative cycles plus the aʿlā subtype). But those are per-class findings, not a root nucleus. A resistant lexicalized nominal class (mala' = 30/40) relative to the fill nucleus, together with an undemonstrated bridge and a decisive counterexample (27:38) plus a syntactic disproof (the opposite roles of مِن), forecloses any unified STRONG/UNIVERSAL grade. The maximal honest root-level statement is: two coherent classes, no Quran-internal bridge — UNRESOLVED at the root level.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The eminent leading assembly/council of a community (or, qualified as ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ, the heavenly council) that speaks, deliberates, conspires, and decides collectively for a people or ruler. A lexicalized collective noun.
clusters.classification_rationale: Always the noun ٱلْمَلَأ in case/definiteness/possessive/vocative variants. It is the grammatical sayer (قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ, recurrent), the addressee for counsel (يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِى 12:43, 27:32; أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى 27:38), the deliberating/conspiring body (إِنَّ ٱلْمَلَأَ يَأْتَمِرُونَ بِكَ 28:20), and a subject of motion (وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ 38:6). The heavenly subtype (37:8, 38:69 إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ) confirms deliberation, not eminence alone, as the through-line, with ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ supplying 'heavenly.'
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: It is a leadership subset (ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ), opposed to أَرَاذِلُنَا (11:27) and ٱلْمُستَضعَفون (7:75), distinct from the malik (12:43, 2:246); moral loading is added by external relative clauses, not the root. Zero filling/capacity content in any of the 30 contexts.

adversarial_verification.notes: No unified root-level claim is asserted, so a root-level falsification is not required. The two classes are each internally distinctive and adversarially clean within their own membership, and the unification hypothesis was actively tested and rejected (26:34 bridge fails; 27:38 counterexample; opposite roles of مِن). Per contract, falsification is NOT_REQUIRED for an unresolved-class-only root.

independent_verification: All three independent lenses (A, B, adversary C) independently reached the identical two-class split and independently rejected the fullness-unification on Quran-internal grounds.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 40 occurrences read with verse_text + QAC morphology; counts verified as 10 (fill family) + 30 (mala') = 40, full coverage.
layer_attribution.derivation: Fill family spans Form I active/passive, Form VIII, active participle مَالِئُون, and verbal noun مِلْء — a morphologically diverse but semantically tight derivational family around 'interior brought/reaching full capacity.'
layer_attribution.lexical_class: ٱلْمَلَأ is a lexicalized collective noun ('deliberative leading assembly'), inflected only for case/definiteness/possession/vocative, with a heavenly subtype via the modifier ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ; it contributes a fixed referential value, not a root nucleus.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Disbelief, arrogance, luxury, and plotting attached to the mala' come from external relative clauses (ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا / ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا) and narrative context (يَأْتَمِرُونَ), NOT from the root; these contextual meanings must not be promoted into the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: No occurrence required preliminary-to-final disposition change; both clusters are internally CONSISTENT and the root-level result is set to UNRESOLVED because the A<->B bridge is undemonstrated, not because any single occurrence flipped.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The unification 'fullness -> the eminent/full body' persists as RESISTANT: it survives only on forbidden external etymology, is defeated by 27:38 and by the opposite roles of مِن, and is not rescued by the sole apparent bridge 26:34; hence two unbridged classes and a root-level UNRESOLVED.

hard_cases.reason: Vocative address to persons asked 'which of you will bring me her throne?' — no container, content, capacity, or quantity; no Class-A fill sense can be substituted. It is the strongest single counterexample to any unified 'fullness' nucleus.

evidence_basis.statement: 27:38:3:2 يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا is a vocative + agentive address to persons; substituting any fill/full/a-fill-of sense yields nonsense, so the two classes do not share an argument structure.

hard_cases.reason: The one apparent A<->B bridge (لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ, 'to the assembly around him'); a monist could allege 'the body that fills the space around the ruler.' It fails: حَوْلَهُ is a locative that places, not fills, and no م ل ا fill-word occurs.

evidence_basis.statement: 26:34:2:3 uses the locative ظرف حَوْلَهُ, never a م ل ا fill-word; reading 'filling the space' imports external etymology the text does not state, so the bridge is undemonstrated.

hard_cases.reason: مِّلْءُ ٱلْأَرْضِ ذَهَبًا is a pure measure of gold with no persons; it resists the Class-B assembly sense entirely and anchors the fill class as quantity/capacity, not council.

evidence_basis.statement: 3:91:11:1 denotes a fill-quantity of the earth in gold (volume, no persons), which cannot be read as an assembly, marking the classes as non-crossing on referent type.

hard_cases.reason: هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ … هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ fixes Class A as 'capacity reached' addressed to Hell, a frame with no assembly reading; it resists any collapse into Class B.

evidence_basis.statement: 50:30:5:1 contrasts fullness (ٱمْتَلَأْتِ) with increase-beyond (مَزِيد), an interior-capacity frame incompatible with the mala' council sense.

hard_cases.reason: ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ, a heavenly deliberating body maximally distant from any fill frame; the aʿlā qualifier, not the root, supplies elevation.

evidence_basis.statement: 37:8:4:2 ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ denotes a heavenly assembly (persons who deliberate), with no filling/capacity cue, resisting unification with the fill class.

hard_cases.reason: ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ marks the exalted mala' as a disputing assembly — deliberation, not fullness — squarely Class B with no bridge cue.

evidence_basis.statement: 38:69:6:3 predicates dispute (يَخْتَصِمُونَ) of the exalted mala', a speech/deliberation act incompatible with a fill/capacity nucleus.

hard_cases.reason: The mala' of the Children of Israel request a king (Ṭālūt) — pure political-leadership content wholly divorced from capacity/filling; a hard counterexample to unity.

evidence_basis.statement: 2:246:4:2 ٱلْمَلَإِ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ act as a petitioning leadership body distinct from the malik, with no filling content, resisting any single-nucleus reading.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The resistance is at the root level: two internally coherent classes with no Quran-internally demonstrated bridge. The listed hard cases mark the seam — the strongest counterexample to unity (27:38), the sole apparent bridge that fails (26:34), the pure-measure fill token (3:91), the capacity endpoint (50:30), the heavenly assemblies most distant from any fill frame (37:8, 38:69), and the purely political council (2:246). No single account absorbs both classes; the unification is logged as RESISTANT.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal bridge that partitions no longer holds: a verse (or a demonstrable shared argument structure) that predicates filling/fullness of ٱلْمَلَأ, or uses a م ل ا fill-word to denote the deliberative assembly, would collapse the two-class partition into one nucleus and overturn the UNRESOLVED verdict.
rejection_condition.search_location: Cross-examine the mala' tokens with any locative/quantity cue (26:34 حَوْلَهُ; the indefinite 11:38 مَلَأٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِ) against the fill tokens (7:18, 50:30, 3:91) for any shared fill+persons frame.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Check whether مِن with ٱلْمَلَأ is ever content-partitive (as in لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ) rather than group-partitive (ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ), and whether any fill-predicate ever takes an assembly as its filled interior.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude external lexicography (the classical 'fill the eye/assembly' derivation) and gloss-driven inference ('chiefs'); require the bridge to be stated by Quranic wording and morphology, not imported etymology or translation convenience.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If no such internal bridge is found, the two classes remain unbridged and the root-level claim stays UNRESOLVED (LOCAL, unresolved-class-only); the per-class descriptions (fill-to-capacity; deliberative assembly) stand only within their own membership.

reopen_conditions: If a re-reading of 26:34 (لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ) or any mala' token can be shown to carry a م ل ا fill-word / capacity predicate from the wording itself (not etymology), reopen the unification of Class A and Class B.

If the indefinite 11:38 (مَلَأٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِ) or the heavenly 37:8/38:69 (ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ) is found to share the content-partitive مِن frame of the fill tokens (7:18, 11:119, 38:85), reopen whether mala' is a fill-derived quantity noun.
If a further occurrence outside this packet predicates filling of an assembly or names fillers as a council, reopen the root-level nucleus question.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: No unified root-level claim is asserted, so a root-level falsification is not required. The two classes are each internally distinctive and adversarially clean within their own membership, and the unification hypothesis was actively tested and rejected (26:34 bridge fails; 27:38 counterexample; opposite roles of مِن). Per contract, falsification is NOT_REQUIRED for an unresolved-class-only root.
